title: The Kindly Hymn
author: Elodie Iversen
blurb: Elodie Vasquez, a pest controller called to something with fingerprints, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. Then the village's church bell rings although the bell was melted down in 1911 — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must hold out until sunrise with the truth about what was invited in before the harvest moon rises.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
